rows.en: Our house is near the school.
There is a very big street here.

rows.ru: На другой стороне улицы второй дом.
rows.en: On the other side of the street there is a second house.
We could live there.

rows.ru: Я не против, земля тут хорошая.
rows.en: I don't mind, the land here is good.
Can you hear me?
Yes, almost everything.
Sometimes you speak very fast.

rows.ru: Лучше слушать каждый день, это необходимо.
rows.en: It is better to listen every day, that is essential.
Thank you, I feel better now.
Do you understand me?
Yes, now I understand.
Where are you from?

rows.ru: Я из Москвы, но три года живу тут.
rows.en: I am from Moscow, but I have lived here for three years.
Well, we'll go into town later.

rows.ru: После работы я медленно иду домой.
rows.en: After work I walk home slowly.

rows.ru: Вдруг я вижу друга на улице.
rows.en: Suddenly I see a friend in the street.

rows.ru: Мы проходим по улице и говорим.
rows.en: We walk along the street and talk.

rows.ru: Сил уже нет, но время ещё есть.
rows.en: I have no strength left, but there is still time.
At home everything stays the way it always is.
I feel bad today.

rows.ru: Врач сказал принимать это три раза в день.
rows.en: The doctor said to take it three times a day.
I can hardly work.
But suddenly it got better.
Thank you, everything is fine now.

rows.ru: Мой любимый писатель пишет новый роман.
rows.en: My favourite writer is writing a new novel.

rows.ru: Он также автор песни, которую все знают.
rows.en: He is also the author of a song everybody knows.
He has a very good voice.

rows.ru: Завтра мы идём на его выставку.
rows.en: Tomorrow we are going to his exhibition.
Afterwards we'll go to the theatre.

rows.ru: На выставке я видел картины одного художника.
rows.en: At the exhibition I saw the paintings of one artist.
The whole country knows his works.
A young musician was playing there too.
My friend prefers literature.
His favourite poet is a singer as well.
Yesterday we were at a concert.
The singer sang for almost three hours.

rows.ru: Её творчество очень любят в нашем городе.
rows.en: Her work is much loved in our town.

rows.ru: Потом мы говорили с актёром и актрисой.
rows.en: Afterwards we talked with an actor and an actress.
They work at a theatre school.

rows.ru: Мы ходили на балет в Москве.
rows.en: We went to the ballet in Moscow.
What beauty!
The performance lasted almost three hours.

rows.ru: Мама сказала, что артисты играли хорошо.
rows.en: Mum said the performers played well.

rows.ru: Русская культура это не только балет и живопись.
rows.en: Russian culture is not only ballet and painting.

rows.ru: Мой друг играет на гитаре каждый день.
rows.en: My friend plays the guitar every day.
It is his favourite guitar.
He often hums the same song.
I don't know what genre it is.

rows.ru: Потом он играет пьесу для нас.
rows.en: Then he plays a piece for us.
There was a big choir on the stage.
Then a girl read a poem.

rows.ru: Но сюжет спектакля я понимаю плохо.
rows.en: But I understand the plot of the play poorly.
Yesterday we watched an action film.
I like that kind of film more.

rows.ru: Сегодня президент говорил о нашей стране.
rows.en: Today the president spoke about our country.
It was an official state programme.
I don't understand political questions well.

rows.ru: Но всё общество слушало его слова.
rows.en: But the whole of society was listening to his words.
Our party was there too.
The government is adopting a new programme.
The minister spoke about it yesterday.

rows.ru: Каждый гражданин может знать, что делает власть.
rows.en: Every citizen may know what those in power are doing.
The state must help families.

rows.ru: Но я не мог найти эту программу.
rows.en: But I could not find that programme.
Our homeland is a big country.
The people want freedom.
The constitution speaks of everyone's freedom.

rows.ru: Мы читали книгу об отечественной истории.
rows.en: We read a book about the history of our country.
This republic is our homeland too.
Parliament worked all day today.
The officials talked about the national programme.

rows.ru: В госдуме об этом говорили три часа.
rows.en: In the Duma they discussed it for three hours.
That minister carries a lot of authority.

rows.ru: А потом мы говорили о губернаторе.
rows.en: And afterwards we talked about the governor.

rows.ru: Мэр нашего города говорил о здравоохранении.
rows.en: The mayor of our town spoke about healthcare.
The governor spoke after him as well.

rows.ru: Потом у них была новая программа.
rows.en: Then they had a new programme.

rows.ru: У нас в стране много национальностей.
rows.en: There are many nationalities in our country.
Politics is not only words.
The chairman spoke about the revolution.
The ambassador was standing next to him.

rows.ru: Он сказал, что это была демократия.
rows.en: He said that this was democracy.
After the revolution life became different.

rows.ru: Потом был большой митинг в городе.
rows.en: Then there was a big rally in the city.

rows.ru: Наш учёный работает над новым исследованием.
rows.en: Our scientist is working on new research.
This is a big discovery.
He loves mathematics most of all.

rows.ru: Каждый час он смотрит на температуру.
rows.en: Every hour he checks the temperature.
There are three elements in this space.
Three people work in the laboratory.
The energy here is very great.
This is a chemical element.

rows.ru: Наша планета очень маленькая, а вселенная огромная.
rows.en: Our planet is very small, and the universe is enormous.
The space laboratory is in Moscow.
We were at the cosmodrome.
Research laboratories work there.
The temperature has to be measured every day.
This invention gave a good result.

rows.ru: Он читает книги о химии и теории.
rows.en: He reads books about chemistry and theory.
My friend loves biology.

rows.ru: Он говорит, что ген это как маленькая программа.
rows.en: He says a gene is like a small programme.
He has a hypothesis of his own.
But it is not a theory yet.

rows.ru: Атом очень маленький, но в нём много энергии.
rows.en: An atom is very small, but there is a lot of energy in it.
